title: Probability as event measure
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and suppose $p\in[0,1]$. Under the product probability distribution on the sign cube with coordinate bias determined by $p$, the biased-minus probability of $f$ equals the probability of the event that $f$ takes the value $-1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
